title: the four behaviour-policy objects get their real names, and the record stops overclaiming
summary: GRANT.md was the session debrief under a name the abp vocabulary reserves for reach; it is now a measured reach record and the debrief has moved to notes/ as what it is. DELTA.md is added, and says the gap is not derivable while the mandate is inferred rather than elicited — an agent subtracting its own inferred mandate from its own measured reach will always report a narrow gap. README maps the vault correctly and carries the versioning steps both agents missed. The colophon no longer claims operator review of the agent-written half. The open list gains five items this session created, including one the record owes upstream to sgit.ai.
